name: katax-skills
description: Skills and agent for the Katax ecosystem: katax-core (validation, null/optional rules, JSON Schema), katax-cli (scaffolding + what to fix after generating), katax-service-manager (bootstrap/runtime), katax-ecosystem (house style: validator/types/repository/controller/handler/routes, hardening), katax-mcp-server (stateless MCP server + OAuth 2.1), plus the katax-project-builder agent to create, extend or refactor katax APIs.
